dataset.citation: Fourcade Y, Ranius T, Öckinger E (2018) Dryad dataset associated with Journal of Animal Ecology 10.1111/1365-2656.12740

published_design.A: mean and SD solar irradiance or other independent site microclimate; area/grazing recorded as patch covariates, not A by default
published_design.B: field-measured host plant density (Filipendula vulgaris and Helianthemum nummularium), only within preselected host-plant habitat patches
published_design.M: site coordinates and independent geographic distance/kernel; separate from published abundance-weighted Si connectivity
published_design.G: butterfly annual summer-generation abundance/occurrence at fixed surveyed patches
published_design.M_leakage_guard: Published Si uses observed abundance Nj; never treat contemporaneous or future-informed Si as an independent movement-only measurement.
published_design.observation_guard: A zero count is nondetection without a calibrated observation channel, not a certified true absence

only_requests: exact DOI versions JSON via documented API
files JSON for that single public version ID
checks: exact two declared CSV paths, no extras or duplicates
file sizes bounded and repository checksums present
outputs: file ID, path, byte size, digest, public metadata link

prerequisites: successful metadata gate and independently approved source identity
one-to-one site key and independently measured A/B/M
time-resolved survey effort and no outcome leakage
future_gate1_not_authorized.goal: read only minimal physical CSV headers/row counts in separate authorized protocol; do not infer B or M until independent measurement semantics verified

scientific_scope: Retrospective empirical proxy-method feasibility only; not independent of published analyses and not EOG-WF endpoint 4
